name: strategy-analysis
description: Run a strategy framework — SWOT/TOWS, Porter's Five Forces, or PESTLE — on a product, company, or market question, choosing the right framework for the question and forcing every cell to carry evidence and a so-what. Use when the user asks for a SWOT, a competitive/market analysis, "should we enter this market", "what's our position against X", or a macro-environment scan.

handoff.when: the options are named and need comparing on stated criteria
handoff.purpose: Score the named options against weighted criteria.
handoff.fallback: If tech-comparison-matrix is absent, build a plain criteria-by-option table inline and state the weights.

handoff.when: the direction is chosen and needs costing before approval
handoff.purpose: Cost the chosen option against a do-nothing baseline.
handoff.fallback: If business-case is absent, state option 0 and the three cost layers (build, run, opportunity) inline.

model.rationale: Framework selection plus evidenced multi-factor judgment ending in a ranked, committal verdict. Cheaper models fill cells with generic filler, skip the TOWS crossings, and refuse to take a side. Never downgrade.
